title: Fairphone 6 Price, Specs and Repairability: Is It Worth Buying?
seo_title: Fairphone 6: Price, Specs, Repairability and Support
meta: The Fairphone 6 is a modular phone with a removable 4,415 mAh battery and a 10/10 iFixit score. Price, specs, software support and who should buy it.
dek: The Fairphone 6 is a modular phone with a removable battery and a top repairability score. This covers the price, the specifications and how long it is supported.

body:
The Fairphone 6 is a modular smartphone launched on 25 June 2025 from EUR 549, designed so that owners can replace parts themselves. It has a 6.31-inch LTPO OLED display, a removable 4,415 mAh battery and an IP55 rating, and iFixit gave it a 10 out of 10 repairability score.

Repair in practice

Twelve components come apart with a single Torx screwdriver. The battery, display, USB-C port and back cover can each be swapped in about five minutes, and official spare parts are listed from roughly US$8 to US$90.

Specifications

  • Display: 6.31-inch LTPO OLED, 10 to 120 Hz.
  • Processor: Qualcomm Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, with 8 GB of RAM and 256 GB of storage plus microSD up to 2 TB.
  • Cameras: 50 MP main with optical stabilisation, 13 MP ultrawide and a 32 MP selfie camera.
  • Battery: removable 4,415 mAh with 30 W charging.

Support and sustainability

Fairphone offers a five-year warranty and guaranteed spare parts. Reviews quote software support to 2032 or 2033, so confirm the exact date with the company. Fairphone says each phone has a carbon footprint of about 30 kg CO2 and uses Fairtrade materials.

The 6+ and the US

A Fairphone 6+ variant has been launched in the United States at US$649.99, according to press coverage, so US availability and pricing differ from the EU model.

Is the Fairphone 6 worth buying?

Buyers who keep phones for many years and would rather replace a battery than a handset. It is not a performance leader against flagships.
